dedupe_keys.name: open solar physics rapid ensemble information

description: OSPREI links CME deflection, propagation and synthetic in-situ profile calculations. Users can run its component models together or separately and generate an evolving event at a selected observer. The resource is documented by JHU APL. The documented physical domain is Solar, Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository, Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The provider describes simplified models; their output richness does not make them equivalent to a full MHD calculation. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.

discovery_routes.query: Complete model catalogue; select one version per model with stated space-weather infrastructure impacts
